resolutions.researcher_notes: Not itemized in PNGRB's line-wise common-carrier register (this is a dedicated GAIL processing-plant-to-power-plant line, not a common-carrier asset, so PNGRB's totals include it but never break it out by name). Reused and verified the prior deep-sweep audit's finding rather than duplicating the search: Global Energy Observatory's independent record for this exact pipeline (globalenergyobservatory.org/geoid/40885, re-verified live via url_verifier — 200 + content present) carries an edit timestamp of 2010-08-15 and already lists it as fully built with Status of Pipeline='Operating Fully', two years before the sheet's StartYear1=2012. gem.wiki's own page attaches no citation to '2012' either. Searched for a GAIL asset-commissioning record or PNGRB authorisation filing that would state a real start year; found none. Since the one independent evidence I have contradicts 2012 rather than supporting it, I am not citing a ref to this value per the no-refs-for-a-different-value rule — flagging for Update to re-derive StartYear1 rather than proposing a replacement I can't source.

Not itemized in PNGRB's line-wise common-carrier register for the same dedicated-line reason as Start. Reused and verified the prior deep-sweep audit's finding: the one primary document with real gas volumes on this exact 12in x 67km Dandewala-Gamnewala-Ramgarh line, Oil India's 2017 EOI (OIL/RP/GLO/EOI/008/2017, Wayback snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20190129120749/http://oil-india.com/pdf/tenders/EOI/Doc_GLO_008_2017.pdf), states a committed quantity of 0.7 MMSCMD with 0.50-0.55 MMSCMD typically lifted by the customer -- 6-9x the sheet's recorded Capacity=0.08 MMSCMD. gem.wiki's own citation for its 0.075 figure is a bare PNGRB homepage link with no line-item behind it (this pipeline isn't in that register at all). Searched for a current GAIL asset filing or PNGRB Schedule-I capacity declaration that might support a low sub-0.1 MMSCMD figure; found none. Not citing a ref to 0.08 since the only real-volume source I found disagrees with it materially -- flagging for Update to re-derive Capacity.

Reused and verified the prior deep-sweep audit's finding. The route and states (Dandewala, Rajasthan -> Ramgarh, Rajasthan) are well-supported by two independent, non-GEM sources that don't cite each other -- Oil India's 2017 EOI ('...Dandewala to Ramgarh with Gamnewala being the intermediate station'; Wayback https://web.archive.org/web/20190129120749/http://oil-india.com/pdf/tenders/EOI/Doc_GLO_008_2017.pdf) and Global Energy Observatory (globalenergyobservatory.org/geoid/40885, re-verified live via url_verifier -- 200 + 'Ramgarh' content present), whose segment name is 'GAIL Gamnewala-RSEB Ramgarh'. But the recorded value cluster for this ref_col also carries EndPrefecture/District='Ramgahr' -- a letter-transposition typo for 'Ramgarh' -- and EndLocation is blank rather than 'Ramgarh'. Every independent source spells it 'Ramgarh' with zero exceptions, so this sub-value in the cluster is objectively wrong. Per the no-refs-for-a-different-value rule I am not pairing a ref to a cluster that contains a misspelled recorded value -- flagging the typo (EndPrefecture/District 'Ramgahr'->'Ramgarh', EndLocation blank->'Ramgarh') for Update to fix first, after which this cluster is fully re-sourceable from the same two citations.
